• Type: stolon
  • Origin: Asia
  • Growth rate: high
  • Height: 20-30+ cm after two months in the tank
  • Light demand: low
  • CO2 demand: low

The plant is supplied as a bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor. Remove the anchor and split into separate plants. For stem plants, remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2 inches). Remove any damaged leaves. Plant the individual plants with some distance between them in the bottom substrate. Roots will develop soon and the plant starts growing.

Vallisneria sp. 'Natans' from Asia is a hardy plant for beginners. It has fine, narrow leaves (50-100 cm long, 1 cm wide) so it does not overshadow other plants much. Easy to propagate using its many runners.
